cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Hlavním cílem je naučit studenty řešit vybrané problémy průmyslové automatizace pomocí průmyslových robotických ramen. Studenti budou schopni navrhovat a implementovat řídicí programy robotických ramen.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Main goal of this subject is to teach students how to solve selected problems of industrial automation using robotic arms. Students will be able to design and implemnt control programs of robotic arms.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to programming of robotic arms (allowance 2/2)2.Settings of safety conditions of UR robots (allowance 2/2)3.Trajectory optimization (allowance 2/2)4.Variables and program control (allowance 2/2)5.Paletization and depaletization (allowance 2/2)6.Using of force and moment sensor (allowance 2/2)7.Multiprocess application and operator inputs (allowance 2/2)8.Deployment and customization (allowance 2/2)9.Advance development techniques useig scripts (allowance 2/2)10.Semestral project (allowance 2/2)11.Semestral project (allowance 2/2)12.Semestral project (allowance 2/2)13.Semestral project (allowance 2/2)14.Semestral project (allowance 2/2)
